_comment: The Wave Ledger (Steve 2026-10-10): wave unlocks run on KILLS only — a per-wave, per-village, per-run point ledger, cumulative across player deaths. Kill = pointsPerKill. A kill executed with the monster's discovered counter = pointsPerCounterKill (mastery bonus; the counter convention lives in src/js/waveLedger.js — wave 1-2 monster defs carry counter data, the bonus is LIVE since 2026-10-10). Per monster-type cap perTypeCap stops farming one type: breadth, not throughput. barsPerWave = point thresholds the ledger for wave N must reach to unlock wave N+1 (the pacing dial Steve will turn). CALIBRATION 2026-10-11 (longsim wave lever): wave-2 bar 5->4 — measured 20 seeds x200d: the w2 bar was the binding constraint on wave 3 (4/20 reached, median fill day 58 vs the day-25 floor — the bar, not the floor, blocked); 4 still needs 2+ monster types (breadth preserved, perTypeCap=2 intact). Day floors: wave 2 needs wave2DayFloor, waves 3+ need dayFloor. Scale gates live in code (w4 regional, w5 national) — unchanged. CALIBRATION 2026-10-11 (longsim wave lever r2): perTypeCap 3 REJECTED, kept at 2 — measured 20 seeds x200d identical vs cap 2: cap 3 filled the w1 bar 6 days earlier (median w2 unlock day 30->24, types-to-fill 6->5) but escalated wave-2 monsters into weaker villages: median survival 69d->50d, 0/20 villages reached day 200 (was 5/20), w2 kills/run 1.8->1.3, w3 unlocks 6/20->4/20, villager w2 vKills 21->8. The cap is a PACING BRAKE on escalation, not just breadth pressure; the w2 throughput problem (~1.9 kills/run) is encounter/combat territory (lever 1), not the cap. w2/w3 breadth at cap 2 is healthy (w3 runs use 3+ types, minimum 2).
